name: frontend
description: A budgeting app built with Electron, React, and .NET
author: Ellie Aghajani

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:5174 && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && mv dist-electron/main.js dist-electron/main.cjs && mv dist-electron/server.js dist-electron/server.cjs && sed -i '' 's/require(\"\.\/server\")/require(\".\/server.cjs\")/' dist-electron/main.cjs && electron dist-electron/main.cjs"
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && mv dist-electron/main.js dist-electron/main.cjs && mv dist-electron/server.js dist-electron/server.cjs && sed -i '' 's/require(\"\.\/server\")/require(\".\/server.cjs\")/' dist-electron/main.cjs && electron-builder
